scripts.bootstrap: npm install --ignore-scripts && npm run install:web && npm run install:h5p
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,H5P,WEB --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:h5p" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:h5p: cross-env PORT=3001 H5P_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000/h5p-engine H5P_DATA_PATH=./services/h5p-engine/h5p H5P_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES=vi,en H5P_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000,http://127.0.0.1:3000 H5P_PARENT_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000 H5P_WEBHOOK_URL=http://localhost:5050/api/h5p/xapi H5P_WEBHOOK_SECRET=dev-only-change-me H5P_INTERNAL_API_KEY=dev-internal-key-change-me node services/h5p-engine/src/index.js
scripts.dev:web: cross-env INTEGRATION_API_KEY=dev-integration-key-change-me API_INTERNAL_URL=http://localhost:5050 npm --prefix apps/web run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
